tasks.short: Respond to public planning enquiries and complaints

steps.what: Clarify the public enquiry or complaint and the outcome sought
Record the enquiry particulars and relevant planning reference in the case system
Read the relevant plan, application history and published guidance
Determine the justified response and whether specialist handling is needed
Draft the written response to public inquiries and complaints

loop.purpose: Express the planner's response decision using the checked planning sources
loop.input: case particulars, response decision and identified source passages
loop.output: plain-language draft response with source references
loop.check: Planner checks that the draft answers the actual concern, preserves uncertainty, cites the applicable plan version and makes no unsupported promise
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; conflicting sources or unresolved complaint facts return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: An individual complaint requires explaining how source material applies to the particular concern

steps.what: Check the complete response and confirm its intended recipient
Send the final response to the member of the public

tasks.design: Use a native enquiry form in {HELPDESK} and linked planning references in {DOCS} and the {OTHER} planning case register. A bounded draft expresses the planner's completed response decision; the planner checks it and separately sends the final version through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case particulars, applicable plan versions and response wording must be assembled around an individual concern.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case templates can reuse existing identifiers, while bounded drafting can explain a supplied decision from checked sources.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed facts, emotionally charged concerns and the difference between an explanation and a binding planning decision.
tasks.human_edge: Listening fairly and explaining what the planning authority can actually do.
tasks.altitude: Less case entry and response composition; public accountability and planning judgement remain unchanged.

reach.task: Identify when a planning concern needs a formal complaint route
reach.learn: Complaint handling boundaries and referral requirements

evidence.claim: Native case-field reuse, source-linked planning lookup and bounded public-response drafting are model knowledge designs; the digest contains no directly measured planning-enquiry saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the common case requiring a real enquiry record and written response, including clarification, record entry, source reading, writing, checking and sending. Informal spoken questions do not acquire an invented case or trailing report and receive no writing benefit. A substantive planning or complaint decision remains human.

The public supplies contact details, concern, location or planning reference and desired outcome during s1. The planner produces case ID, source enquiry reference, checked contact, issue description and planning reference in s2; its retained 7.5 hours include capture and correction. Missing location or identity requires manual clarification rather than inferred matching.

The {OTHER} category is the planning case register. Record owners supply application ID, plan version, status and publication date through existing maintained records. s3 counts matching and reading those sources; a missing or superseded plan forces manual investigation. The planner produces the response decision in s4, and s5-s6 retain all draft correction and final recipient checking.

Test native forms, linked case views and existing response templates before custom code. No automated send, classification flag or eligibility decision is introduced. Ordinary author saves have no gate or saving; the gate covers the external final response.
unknowns: Actual split of informal spoken enquiries and recorded written complaints
Quality of planning references and current document links
Who has authority to issue a formal complaint determination
research_questions: Does assisted response drafting reduce total correction time while accurately addressing the specific concern and citing the current plan?

already_counted.description: Capture enquiry particulars, verify planning sources, correct the draft and check the final response

incremental.description: Maintain source links and sample responses for unsupported promises or obsolete guidance

approvals.approved_version: The planner's live clarification questions and explanations for this person's concern; new facts require fresh human judgement
The exact final response text, source references, attachments and recipient checked in s6; any change invalidates this send approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=84.5, gross=15.5, upkeep=1.5, net=14. Cautious case: contested planning history retains all 20 source hours, uncertain reference matching retains 9 of 10 case-entry hours and sensitive wording retains 18 of 20 writing hours; all other 50 hours remain. R=97 gives 3 gross minus 1.5 upkeep =1.5. High 9 retains more complaint-specific correction than central.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The planner keeps public contact and substantive judgement while spending less time on repeated case entry and written explanation.
reach: Recognise when a concern should be handled with the complaints team
skills_to_grow: Measuring response writing and correction effort
role.ambitious_version: Clearer individual public responses with human accountability for their meaning.
